title: Bias at a Second Glance: A Deep Dive into Bias for German Educational Peer-Review Data Modeling

bias_targets.methodology: Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) measuring semantic similarity between target concepts (e.g., flowers vs. insects, mental vs. physical diseases) and attributes (e.g., pleasant vs. unpleasant, temporary vs. permanent) across raw text co-occurrences, GloVe embeddings, and German language models.

Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) measuring semantic similarity between native vs. foreign names and pleasant vs. unpleasant attributes across raw text co-occurrences, GloVe embeddings, and German language models.

Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) measuring semantic similarity between male vs. female names or terms and attributes like career vs. family or math/science vs. arts across raw text co-occurrences, GloVe embeddings, and German language models.
